decision: The competitor (Renault Sport Formula One Team) is fined €600.
event_name: Renault Sport Formula One Team Document 49 Date 24 June 2018 Time 17:57 2018 FRENCH GRAND PRIX 21 - 24 June 2018 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
offence: Breach of Article 22.10 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
reason: Car 55 exceeded the pit lane speed limit which is set at 60 km/h for this Event by 5.5 km/h. Garry Connelly Enzo Spano Yannick Dalmas Jean-Marie Krempff
